status: post-open source-qualified candidate; fresh objects remain unopened for this method
claim_boundary: This source study may authorize one no-refit evaluation on genuinely fresh Deform360 physical objects. It is not independent confirmation, calibrated safety evidence, official Deform360 Table-4 parity, or a state-of-the-art claim.
hypothesis: A dense camera-derived discrepancy update improves a selected physical/persistence trajectory only when the action-conditioned physical twin supports motion of comparable scale and a source-calibrated upper regret bound is strictly negative.

open27_pairwise_positive.result: The raw pairwise-clique RBF update improved hidden identity RMSE by 15.74% and hidden Chamfer by 14.10% relative to the selected physical/persistence backbone across five opened objects, but had no baseline-relative regret guard.

prospective_camera_only_failure.result: The camera-only update regressed every one of twelve prospective object means because action-only windows made persistence nearly exact and coherent multiview bias passed camera-internal geometry checks.

source_panel.aggregation: equal intervals within case, equal cases within physical object, equal physical objects

implementation.regeneration_check: Every report, feature, score, and interval regret matched the prior development payload in all 27 cases.

runtime_candidate.base_backbone: per-update selected physical prior or exact persistence using current prefix observation Chamfer; persistence is the insufficient-support default
runtime_candidate.camera_candidate: unchanged pairwise-consensus full-blend recursive RBF correction
runtime_candidate.three_view_redundancy_role: regret feature rather than brittle hard admission threshold
runtime_candidate.correction_bound: radial RMS correction is deterministically shrunk relative to the larger of prefix physical response and physical-versus-persistence future response
runtime_candidate.static_policy: zero physical response returns the selected baseline bit-for-bit

source_regret_certificate.selection: candidate must lie in source feature support and have strictly negative upper regret

decision.fresh_protocol_requirement: Exclude every previously opened, reserved, selected, or technically dispositioned physical object; preflight source and backend contracts before locking; seal all eligible predictions before any future target is opened; retain failures without replacement.
